items.text_th: โหลด โกลบอลกับvgn มาพร้อมกัน กดเข้า vgn เลย ไม่ต้องใส่รหัสอะไร มันเชื่อมโยงให้เลย เพราะพึ่งทำได้เองขึ้นแบบนี้เลย ลองดูน้า

items.text_en: Install both Global and VNG at the same time, then open VNG directly; no code needed, it links automatically. I just did it when I got the same message, give it a try.
items.summary_vn: Chỉ cách: cài cả Global và VNG, vào VNG là tự liên kết.
items.summary_en: Tip: install both Global and VNG; opening VNG links the account automatically.
items.theme: Đăng nhập tài khoản

items.text_th: ถ้าเคยรับรหัสแล้วไปทำการย้ายแล้วครั้งหนึ่ง ก็โหลด vng มาแล้วกดเข้าที่เริ่มใหม่ เชื่อมกับเฟซ หรือเมลของไอดีเราเลยครับ ไม่ต้องขอรหัสซ้ำอีกครั้ง
items.text_vn: Nếu từng nhận mã và chuyển một lần rồi thì tải VNG, bấm bắt đầu lại rồi liên kết với Facebook hoặc email của ID mình là được, không cần xin mã lại.
items.text_en: If you already got the code and moved once, just install VNG, start again and link with the Facebook or email of your ID; no need to request the code again.
items.summary_vn: Chỉ cách: đã chuyển rồi thì đăng nhập VNG bằng Facebook/email cũ, không cần mã mới.
items.summary_en: Tip: if already migrated, log into VNG with the old Facebook/email; no new code needed.

items.text_en: Take the Gmail that is linked in the green slot and try linking it in the blue slot with the sun icon.

items.text_th: ไม่รู้จะช่วยได้มั้ยแค่เพื่อนเราก็เป็นประมาณนี้ เมลเดียวกัน โหลด VGN มาเผลอไปล้อคอินก่อนทำให้พอไปเอารกัสจากโกลบอลมาใส่ไม่ได้ต้องยื่นเรื่องลบตัวละคร เพื่อนเราใช้วิธีเชื่อมเฟซบุ้คในแอคโกลบอลแล้วเอามาเข้าใน vgn คั้บ
items.text_vn: Không biết có giúp được không, bạn mình cũng bị gần y vậy: cùng một email, tải VNG rồi lỡ đăng nhập trước nên lấy mã từ Global sang không nhập được, phải yêu cầu xoá nhân vật. Bạn mình liên kết Facebook trong tài khoản Global rồi dùng nó đăng nhập vào VNG.
items.text_en: Not sure if this helps, but my friend had nearly the same issue: same email, installed VNG and accidentally logged in first, so the code from Global could not be entered and they had to request character deletion. My friend linked Facebook in the Global account and then used it to log into VNG.
items.summary_vn: Kể bạn lỡ đăng nhập VNG trước nên phải xoá nhân vật; cách xử lý là liên kết Facebook ở Global.
items.summary_en: A friend logged into VNG first and had to delete the character; fix was linking Facebook on Global.
items.theme: Đăng nhập tài khoản

สร้างอีเมล์ใหม่ หรือเฟสบุคใหม่ (ที่ยังไม่เคยเชื่อมต่ออะไรเลย)
หลังจากนั้นเราลบแอพ vgn แล้วโหลดใหม่
ทำตามเสตปเดิมเลยค่ะ เข้า vgn กดไปรับโค้ดย้าย คัดลอกโค้ดย้าย กลับมาที่ vgn หลังจากนั้น ระบบจะถามว่า เราล๊อคอินด้วยอะไร ให้เลือก เมล์ใหม่หรือเฟสบุคใหม่ที่เราเพิ่งสร้าง แล้วรอสักครู่ก็ย้ายสำเร็จค่ะ
items.text_vn: Hôm qua mình làm cũng hiện y vậy. Hoá ra bên Global mình đã gắn email, Facebook nên chuyển không được vì nhân vật đã bị gắn. Mình xử lý bằng cách: tạo email mới hoặc Facebook mới (chưa từng liên kết gì), sau đó xoá app VNG rồi tải lại, làm theo các bước cũ: vào VNG, bấm nhận mã chuyển, copy mã, quay lại VNG; hệ thống hỏi đăng nhập bằng gì thì chọn email/Facebook mới vừa tạo, đợi chút là chuyển thành công.
items.text_en: Yesterday I got the same message. It turned out my Global account was tied to an email and Facebook, so the move failed because the character was already bound. I fixed it by creating a new email or Facebook (never linked to anything), deleting and reinstalling the VNG app, then following the same steps: open VNG, get the transfer code, copy it, go back to VNG; when it asks how to log in, pick the new email/Facebook, wait a moment and the move succeeds.
items.summary_vn: Hướng dẫn chi tiết cách sửa lỗi "đã liên kết" khi chuyển sang VNG bằng email/Facebook mới.
items.summary_en: Detailed steps to fix the "already linked" error when moving to VNG using a new email/Facebook.

items.text_th: สู้ๆค่ะ ตั้งแต่เล่นเกมนี้มาเกือบๆ 2 ปีแล้ว เราเคยเติมยังไม่ถึง 200 เลยมั้ง พูดง่ายๆก็คือสายฟรีนั่นแหละ กล่องสุ่มก็เน้นดวงล้วนๆกว่าจะได้ของดีแต่ละอย่างก็หมดไปเยอะ กดสุ่มไปแบบไม่คิดอะไรมากเพราะอัญมณีเดี๋ยวพอทำเควสทำผลงานได้มันก็มีให้ตลอด ถ้ามัวแต่เสียดายที่ต้องใช้เราก็จะไม่ได้อะไรเลยเราคิดแบบนี้นะ เล่นให้สนุกค่ะ เหรียญอัปเกรดเราก็สะสมไปเรื่อยๆมาตลอดเลยมีเยอะ กิจกรรมนี้เราจะเน้นกระโดดหาตัวบอสจิ๋วไปยืนใต้ท้องมันเพื่อไม่ให้โดนโจมตีจนกว่าจะฆ่ามันสำเร็จ กินเครื่องดื่มกระโดดไม่ให้ขาด…
items.text_vn: Cố lên nha. Mình chơi game này gần 2 năm mà nạp chắc chưa tới 200, nói chung là dân chơi free. Hộp quay thì toàn dựa vào hên xui, muốn ra đồ ngon mỗi món cũng tốn nhiều. Mình cứ quay không nghĩ nhiều vì đá quý làm nhiệm vụ, thành tích là có lại hoài; cứ tiếc không dám dùng thì chẳng được gì. Chơi cho vui thôi. Xu nâng cấp mình tích dần nên có nhiều. Sự kiện này mình nhảy tới con boss tí hon, đứng dưới bụng nó để không bị đánh tới khi giết được, uống nước nhảy liên tục…
items.text_en: Hang in there. I have played this game for almost 2 years and topped up less than 200 baht, basically free-to-play. Gacha boxes are pure luck and each good item costs a lot. I just roll without overthinking because gems keep coming from quests and achievements; if you hold back you get nothing. Play for fun. I saved upgrade coins over time so I have plenty. For this event I jump to the mini boss and stand under its belly so it cannot hit me until I kill it, and keep drinking jump drinks…
items.summary_vn: Động viên người chơi nản sự kiện bắn quái; chia sẻ kinh nghiệm chơi free và mẹo đứng dưới boss tí hon.
items.summary_en: Encourages a frustrated player; shares free-to-play mindset and a tip to stand under the mini boss.
